'''Hutch''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] and [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] of a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nuendo Rash]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had no sense of humor, and objected to Rash's dumping of several [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] onto [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] over a dispute concerning Rash's debt of twenty thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
